title: version and --version print one line with the version, the commit, the Go version and the platform, and exit 0
source: intended: a binary that says what it is (docs/decisions.md D4, the release plan)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-21, version). The oracle has no `version` command and no `--version` flag: both words are an unknown command (exit 2, the usage on stderr). The case pins the shape of the line only, not its value: the stamped version cannot be built inside a case, and a binary built without a stamp prints `dev` or the module version.
